catalog.name: Weather
catalog.description: Weather widget that loads a default location on its own, so it can be shown without asking for a place. Current shows conditions in detail, hourly shows the next 12 hours, weekly shows 7 days, and compact is a one-line strip with location, temperature and condition for when weather should take very little space.

current.description: Current conditions with a large temperature, icon, high and low, and wind. Needs a medium or large region.

compact.description: A one-line strip with location, temperature and condition, made for small or thin regions such as a short row under another Vessel. Use it when the user asks for weather to be small, minimal, compact or tucked away. It is readable at a single row of height, so give it the smallest share: about one eighth of the height next to its neighbour (a weight of 1 against 7 or more), not a quarter.

catalog.name: Labs
catalog.description: Demo-only lab marker selection with list and trends views. Use `labs-main` for the primary Instance ID; use a distinct ID for any additional Labs Instance. Requests to open or add the Labs panel can display its empty default trends view. No lab results or trend data are available; explain this limitation when opening the panel. Opening the panel does not retrieve or analyze results. Selecting a marker changes only its label; never claim measurements, trends or medical advice.

actions.name: showTrends
actions.description: Open the trends view; no trend data is available

actions.name: showList
actions.description: Open the list view; no lab results are available

actions.name: selectMarker
actions.description: Select a marker label only; no trend data is available

parameters.name: markerSlug
parameters.description: Marker to select: hemoglobin, platelets or glucose

catalog.name: Calendar
catalog.description: Calendar widget for viewing dates and scheduling. Supports month view, week view, and day view with hourly time blocks. Every view also supports addEvent, removeEvent, and moveEvent for today's schedule — use these whenever the user adds, cancels, or reschedules something for today. Today's day view starts with a 7:30 AM "Gym" and a 10:00 AM "Design review — Studio Vortex HQ". When the user asks about getting somewhere or being there by a time, pair with the map vessel's showRoute action, passing the event's location (e.g. "Studio Vortex HQ") as the destination.
